lines.text: Many learners say: I am having two brothers.
Use have for things you own.
Has! She has a big house.

data.why: Use have for things you own.
data.memory: I have, not I am having.

native.tip: अपने पास कुछ होने के लिए “I have” बोलें, “I am having” नहीं।
native.caption: क्या आप भी कहते हैं “I am having two brothers”? 😅 अंग्रेज़ी में “I have two brothers” सही है, क्योंकि have के साथ -ing नहीं लगता। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “has”। अपने पास कुछ होने या रिश्ते बताने के लिए have बोलें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ करें: {link}

en.tip: To say you own something, say “I have”, not “I am having”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am having two brothers”? 😅 In English “I have two brothers” is right, because have does not take -ing. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
